release_name: Live TV v5.1.19 (Build 54) — Touch & Scroll Controls Stability Fix
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 👆 Player Controls Touch & Scroll Lock: Touching, swiping, or horizontally scrolling through the top action pills and quick-switch channel carousel will NEVER prematurely hide the controls overlay
🛡️ Dedicated Touch Interaction Engine: Active gesture tracking on touchstart, touchmove, and scroll with a 4-second grace period after releasing your finger before auto-hide timer resumes
🎯 Accurate Backdrop Tap Detection: Clicks and touches anywhere inside controls containers no longer trigger false background dismissals
📱 Mobile Header Smooth Swipe: The entire top header bar glides horizontally with inertial touch scrolling on phones
⇄ Last Channel Recall (Q): Instant flashback toggle between current and previous channel
🎚️ Web Audio Lip-Sync Offset: Real-time delay compensation (-500ms to +1500ms)
🔍 In-Player Spotlight Channel Search (/): Instant modal HUD search across all 2,989+ channels without exiting fullscreen
🔔 Live Sports Match Reminders: Set alerts on upcoming matches with synthesized chime and 1-click tune
🔎 Custom Video Zoom & Pan: Multi-level zoom with touch pinch and drag-to-pan
↻ Stream Auto-Retry & Reconnect: 3-stage automatic stall recovery and instant reload
